title: Egyptian Banana Fritters
description: A delicious dessert inspired by Egyptian cuisine, fritters made with ripe bananas and a hint of warm spices.
instructions: Mash the bananas in a large bowl until smooth.
Add the warm spices, sugar, and mix until well combined.
Add the pre-made or homemade fritters to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop the dough into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
